description: Reverie is a modular digital painting and raster manipulation framework. The system is partitioned into the core graphics engine providing world, layer, and stroke models, an HTML5 canvas 2D rendering pipeline, an image exporter with format encoders, a web client layer providing high-level canvas facades and drawing session management, and a demo application suite with profiling benchmarks.

components.name: Core Graphics Engine
components.description: Provides fundamental domain models, raster data structures, stroke dynamics, brush behaviors, history tracking, and document serialization.

components.name: Brush and Selection Tools
components.description: Implements brush dynamics, stamp footprint generation, and polygon selection masking.

components.name: Raster and Tile Storage
components.description: Manages tile-backed raster data structures, pixel writing operations, and tile rendering pipelines.

components.name: World and Camera Management
components.description: Maintains the canvas document model, raster layer hierarchy, viewports, and camera projections.

components.name: Document Serialization and Migration
components.description: Handles document serialization, deserialization, schema validation, and version migrations.

components.name: Rendering and View Types
components.description: Defines core rendering contracts, pixel coordinate models, and view configuration interfaces.

components.name: Stroke Interpolation and Sampling
components.description: Samples, resamples, and interpolates input strokes into discrete stamp placement events.

components.name: Core Mathematical Utilities
components.description: Provides shared mathematical assertions, pseudorandom generation, and coordinate helpers.

components.name: Project Container Packaging
components.description: Encodes and decodes multi-part project archives and container manifests for export and import.

components.name: Error Handling and Rasterization Primitives
components.description: Defines domain error classes, diagnostic definitions, and low-level circle rasterization algorithms.

components.name: History and Transaction Management
components.description: Tracks undo and redo history records and manages transactional raster tile snapshots.

components.name: Paint Execution and Blending
components.description: Executes direct pixel painting, paint targeting, and source-over pixel blending modes.

components.name: Color Blending Primitives
components.description: Performs RGBA channel-level arithmetic, color clamping, and color representation validation.

components.name: Composition and Region Utilities
components.description: Provides tile composition utilities, render region intersection math, and source resolution.
